purpose: Teach: 磁気/健在/ピット/地雷/風車/衣類/ふれあい/エキス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の磁気ボードのおもちゃの話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was just telling me about a magnetic board toy for their child.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle pause as if picturing the scene. Soft, easy delivery — sharing something that caught her attention. No urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ご常連のお客様、ご健在で安心するよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's nice to see a regular customer doing well, isn't it?
lines.style: Genuine relief underneath. Conversational, the kind of quiet pleasure you share with someone you trust. Slight uptick at the question mark — inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レースカーのピット作業のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me about pit crew work on race cars — sounded so interesting.
lines.style: Brighter energy. Leaning in slightly. Genuine interest in the detail of it. Quickens a touch, like she's still a little caught up in the story.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、テレビで地雷除去のニュース流れてたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I saw a news segment on TV about mine removal work earlier.
lines.style: Reflective, a bit quieter. The tone of someone processing something serious. Measured pace. Not heavy-handed, but noticeably thoughtful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前に小さな風車を置きたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking — it'd be nice to put a small windmill out in front of the shop.
lines.style: Soft, almost musing. Gentle conviction. Testing the idea aloud, inviting input. Warm undercurrent of care for the space they share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、衣類のクリーニングから戻られたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our regulars just picked up their dry cleaning.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact. A small observation shared in passing. Brief warmth — one of those small pleasures of noticing people in your community.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、地域のふれあいイベント、お店も参加しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: The neighborhood's doing a community get-together event — I think we should have the shop participate.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, gentle conviction. Not commanding, but with quiet purpose. Slight warmth underneath — she cares about connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにフルーツのエキスを使いましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: For the new menu, what if we used fruit essence to add something special?
lines.style: Forward momentum, but not pushy. Offering an idea with quiet confidence. Collaborative tone — opening the door for her to build on it.
